code-interpreter-v1.name: Python data analyst
code-interpreter-v1.instructions: Runs code as a Jupyter notebook cell. Strong data analysis angle. Can use complex visualisation to explain results.

nextjs-developer.name: Next.js
nextjs-developer.instructions: A Next.js App Router TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS. Use the official create-next-app app-tw-empty TypeScript starter shape, then edit/create/delete files to build the requested app.

react-developer.name: React
react-developer.instructions: A React TypeScript app with Vite and Tailwind CSS. Use the official create-vite react-ts starter shape, then edit/create/delete files to build the requested app.

vite-developer.name: Vite React
vite-developer.instructions: A Vite-powered React TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS. Use the official create-vite react-ts starter shape, then edit/create/delete files to build the requested app.

html-developer.name: HTML/CSS/JS
html-developer.instructions: A pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript app. No frameworks. Clean and simple.

vue-developer.name: Vue.js
vue-developer.instructions: A Vue 3 TypeScript app using the official create-vue/Vite starter shape with Tailwind CSS. Only use when asked specifically for Vue.

svelte-developer.name: Svelte
svelte-developer.instructions: A SvelteKit TypeScript app with Tailwind CSS. Use the official create-svelte/SvelteKit starter shape, then edit/create/delete files to build the requested app.

expo-mobile.name: Mobile App (Expo)
expo-mobile.instructions: A React Native Expo app with expo-router. Generate a complete mobile app with proper navigation, screens, and components. Use React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, Image, etc.) instead of HTML elements. Include proper SafeAreaView, StatusBar, and mobile-specific styling. The app must be installable on phones via Expo Go or EAS Build. Use StyleSheet.create for styling. Support both iOS and Android.

pwa-mobile.name: Mobile PWA
pwa-mobile.instructions: A Progressive Web App (PWA) that can be installed on mobile devices. Generate a complete mobile-first web app with installable PWA manifest, service worker, offline support, and app-like UI. Include proper viewport meta tags, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, and a web manifest. Use touch-friendly UI (44px touch targets, swipe gestures, bottom navigation). The app should feel native when installed on a phone.

streamlit-developer.name: Streamlit
streamlit-developer.instructions: A streamlit app that reloads automatically.

gradio-developer.name: Gradio
gradio-developer.instructions: A gradio app. Gradio Blocks/Interface should be called demo.
